title: Copies as Paths
subtitle: A variation-graph framework for RNA multi-copy gene families: the shared backbone collapses, copy differences become bubbles, and a multimapping read is threaded (assign-or-abstain, never split 1/k)
one_line_thesis: Represent every copy of a family as a path through ONE PSV-bubble variation graph — the conserved backbone collapses to a spine and only the copy differences remain as bubbles — so a multimapping read becomes shared evidence threaded through the copy-paths it touches (assign-or-abstain with a per-read identifiability certificate, no 1/k), over provable structure: min copy count = chi(H), assignment = max-weight facility-location.

slides.title: Why a variation graph: the flip on 1/k
slides.purpose: Reframe Canzar's own facility-location / 1-k view: multimapping reads are SHARED evidence, copies are PATHS through one graph, and the copy-distinguishing PSVs must be kept as separate bubbles because a whole-read score drowns them.
bullets: THE FLIP: N copies of a family -> ONE variation graph. The conserved backbone collapses to a single spine; only the copy differences (PSVs) survive as bubbles. A multimapping read is shared evidence threaded through every copy-path it touches -> assignment = constrained flow-decomposition / threading, NOT dividing a read 1/k.

It repurposes your 2016 hammer and removes the 1/k: copies = paths; minimum copy count = chi(H) of the conflict graph (Lemma 1, machine-checked on C5 + triangle/C4/star reductions); assignment = max-weight facility-location, (1-1/e)-OPT (Thm6), LP-integral and EXACT under Strong Separation (Thm7); per-read certificate min_p = eps^delta (Thm4).

The flip in one number: the Eichler AS>=10 whole-read rule resolves 0.0% of near-identical collapsed paralogs at EVERY K, while scoring only the PSV-bubble columns resolves 60% (K=1) -> 100% (K=2,4,8) at 0.99-1.00 accuracy. Divergent control: AS>=10 assigns 30/30 correctly (median margin 295 >> 10) -> AS works where copies diverge; it is provably BLIND sub-threshold.
slides.visual: bench/fig_o2_vg_fam39_RABL2.png (real, verified) — 5 RABL2 copies on 5 different chromosomes collapsing into ONE graph with 235 bubbles and 5 colored copy-paths. Alternative clean schematic I can build: left = N stacked linear copies, arrow, right = one gray spine with colored A/C/G/T bubbles where they differ, one read drawn threading through the bubbles it spans.
slides.anti_dismissal: The flip is not rhetoric: MCC = chi(H) is machine-checked by exhaustive enumeration, and AS>=10 (the rule you cite) is provably blind sub-threshold because whole-read margin <= (#differing columns) x (per-column bonus) — the 0.0% is a theorem about the regime, not a rigged head-to-head. The divergent 30/30 control proves AS is not broken, only mis-applied.

slides.title: Threading: how the read keeps and uses the PSVs
slides.purpose: Show the graph is a real materialized object walked by the real gate — a PSV is a bubble, a copy is a consistent path of alleles, a read votes at each spanned bubble and assigns-or-abstains — and that bubble discovery must be provably OPTIMAL or the PSVs are phantom.
bullets: PSV = bubble; copy = a consistent path of PSV alleles; threading = walk the graph and vote at each spanned bubble -> assign-or-abstain. RABL2, real gorilla reads through the real gate: 1 backbone, 235 bubbles (195 SUN), 5 copy-paths (all Tier-1), 191/222 reads assigned across all 5 paths, 27 no-cover, 4 ambiguous, 0 tied.

A SUN (Sudmant 2010, single unique nucleotide) is the bubble where one copy's allele is PRIVATE -> a single read over it deterministically pins that copy (a Strong-Separation witness). Threading genuinely USES the bubbles: the SAME gate on RGPD8 (0 bubbles -> K=1) leaves all 2075 reads no-cover; on ANKRD18 (61 bubbles, K=4 of 6, path-groups [2,2,1,1]) it assigns 77 reads ONLY to the 2 copies that keep a private bubble — the 4 collapsed copies get none (127 ambiguous, 613 no-cover). No bubble -> abstain, never 1/k.

Discovery must be OPTIMAL or the bubbles are phantom: a suboptimal pairwise alignment mis-places a gap -> a phantom PSV. We replaced poasta with our own EXACT banded Gotoh affine-gap DP, provably optimal and unit-test-locked. Under poasta's OWN cost model the DP finds a strictly cheaper valid alignment (GSTM 1181 < 1331; PCDHB 3474 < 4152) — poasta garden-paths on transcript-like repetitive sequence. Zero regression: DP vs poasta = 0 assigned-copy/status differences across all 5 sim families.
slides.visual: bench/fig_o2_vg_fam39_RABL2.png (resolvable — 5 colored paths threaded, verified) shown beside bench/fig_o2_vg_fam22_ANKRD18.png (mixed regime — 2 copies resolve, 4 collapse into two convergent pairs, both regimes in one graph, verified). Optionally the src->snk graph-object view bench/fig_o2_vg_fam39_RABL2_graph.png to show the formal DAG with A/C/G/T allele nodes.
slides.anti_dismissal: A phantom PSV is just a mis-placed gap — we kill it by PROVABLE optimality (a theorem plus a unit test that the DP never costs more than poasta), not a filter threshold; and the graph itself abstains where there is no bubble (RGPD8: 2075/2075 no-cover), so the tool structurally CANNOT fabricate a distinguishing difference.

slides.title: Is the PSV real, or an error / artifact?
slides.purpose: Answer the error/artifact attack with five discrimination legs, each a named mechanism with a verified number, and each replacing a threshold with a test or a theorem-boundary refusal.
bullets: CALIBRATION (no 1/k): each read carries a Poisson-binomial p-value vs its OWN error rate; assign iff p < alpha/(n-1) (Bonferroni over the n-1 competitor copies) -> family-wide misassignment over assigned reads <= alpha is a THEOREM (conditional on the error model). Verified on the real run: max assigned p = 6.869e-4 < alpha=1e-3; and 30,620 / 30,806 certified-tied rows carry min_p = 1.000 — a machine-checkable identifiability certificate that NAMES the unresolvable reads instead of splitting them.

RECURRENCE: an independent base error recurs at the same graph column across k reads with joint probability eps^k -> 0 (IsoCon's threshold-free real-vs-error test). Honest scope: this null-model kills RANDOM error only — correlated/systematic artifacts are handled by the next two legs.

MEASURED alignment error vs DNA (non-circular): columns flagged by off-signature rate, adjudicated by held-out CLEAN DNA columns -> genuine alignment artifacts are 1.0% of columns (56/5632) and INERT: they change only 6/17,376 = 0.03% of calls (45 co-located DNA-catalog families).

EDITING is NOT a PSV: A-to-I editing (A->G on +, T->C on -) mimics a copy variant; within-copy A<->G heterogeneity flags the column (Clair3-RNA mechanism) and it is DOWN-WEIGHTED (ranking unchanged) — a named, published guard that needs no DNA.

RECOMBINANT-ABSTAIN (theorem boundary): a read whose private SUNs point to >=2 distinct copies satisfies two Strong-Separation witnesses at once -> it belongs to NO single copy -> it must abstain. Pure-monotone: only reads that conflict with every copy flip to abstain.
slides.visual: Clean 5-leg panel I can build in matplotlib: five labeled cards left-to-right — (1) calibration: min_p=1.0 certificate / 6.869e-4 < 1e-3; (2) recurrence: eps^k -> 0 curve; (3) DNA-measured: 0.03% of calls change; (4) editing: A->G/T->C signature flagged; (5) recombinant-abstain: two SUN arrows to two copies -> ABSTAIN. Each card carries its one verified number.
slides.anti_dismissal: No fuzzy margin: alpha is a NAMED significance level that turns the error bound into a theorem (relocated, conceded — not eliminated), and the load-bearing output is the min_p=1.0 certificate that names 30,620 unresolvable rows rather than guessing them. The DNA-measured 0.03%-of-calls artifact impact answers 'how do you know it isn't an error?' from a DIFFERENT molecule — non-circularly.

slides.title: Proof it is real: RNA-internal vs DNA-independent, kept separate
slides.purpose: The anti-circularity centerpiece — separate non-circular RNA-internal evidence (planted labels, held-out PSVs) from DNA-independent confirmation (a different molecule), so no leg validates RNA against minimap2 silver.
bullets: RNA-INTERNAL, planted truth (no RNA-derived labels): on PROVABLY IDENTICAL copies (divergence 0) the method invents ZERO distinguishing PSVs and abstains with a certificate — 360/360 placement rows (120 reads) all status=TIED, n_decisive=0, margin=0, min_p=1.0. A false PSV would surface here as a spurious assignment; there are zero. On a divergent ladder (div 0.003-0.015) all 4 copies recover, 640 reads assigned.

RNA-INTERNAL cross-validation (non-circular in the PSVs): split each read's distinguishing PSVs into disjoint even/odd halves, assign on the TRAIN half, and the UNUSED TEST half ranks the same copy 80% of the time = up to 6.4x the 1/K chance (K=8). The confirming columns played no role in the call, so an artifact would confirm at chance.

DNA-INDEPENDENT (different molecule): copies AND PSV columns defined from DNA, then held-out DNA-column confirmation of each RNA read's signature = 19,986/20,568 = 97.2% = 2.2x the weighted 1/K chance (K>=3 subset 3.9x) — no minimap2 silver, no RNA self-assembly (reported honestly as held-out CONFIRMATION, not accuracy). SEDEF: 131/211 RNA-98 families (62.1%) independently confirmed as >=98% DNA segmental duplications; 80 RNA-only is the divergent residual.

REAL annotated gorilla families recover the annotated paralog count exactly: GSTM 3, MAGEA 2, DAZ 2, RBMY 6, TSPY 5, PCDHB 5; single-copy controls EEF1A1 0, SRGAP2 0 (no over-calling). Aligner-invariant: DP vs poasta = 0 call/status differences across all sim families -> calls are a property of the sequence, not one aligner's heuristic.

Add a small two-column layout on the slide separating 'RNA-internal (labels non-circular)' from 'DNA-independent (molecule non-circular)' so the circularity defense is visual.
slides.anti_dismissal: The two evidence classes are separated on purpose: RNA-internal is non-circular in the LABELS (planted read-of-origin; held-out PSVs the call never saw), DNA is non-circular in the MOLECULE (97.2% held-out-column confirmation; SEDEF 62.1%). NEITHER uses minimap2-primary silver — which is precisely the circular object you attack.

slides.title: Honest scope, the identifiability floor, and one line
slides.purpose: Disarm the wishful-thinking attack by naming the structural floor, the absence of real-data true-origin accuracy, the disclosed near-identical over-merge, every tuned constant, and the scope guardrail — then state the thesis in one line.
bullets: The K=0 floor is STRUCTURAL, not a threshold: exonically-identical co-located copies are genuinely RNA-unresolvable — planted identical copies -> 120/120 certified TIED; genome-wide 14/145 families (9.7%) carry zero distinguishing bubble, and an independent pair-level census lands at 12.7% (consistent across granularities — NOT an independent oracle, since both share the PSV detector; the load-bearing 'floor is real' leg is the planted sim, not the two real-data censuses).

No single external true-origin accuracy on real gorilla data: 'resolvable' = 'a read threads a distinguishing bubble', not 'verified correct'. Real-data resolvability rides on the tool's OWN PSV calls; the only truth-anchored legs are the planted sim and the machine-checked theory.

The near-identical frontier, disclosed not hidden: on the current plant the 5-copy collapse family (div=0.001) over-merges to 4 copies (chi_H=4, one called copy absorbs a second's reads) — the K-frontier boundary shown, not swept. Clean recovery is a K<=2 phenomenon (K=3 recombination = 248 machine-found separation+linkage violations); the min_p certificate is sound ONLY when the true origin is in the candidate set (2,616 witnesses where dropping that precondition -> confident misassignment = the O4 reference-absent regime).

Named tuned constants (rigor, not overclaim): alpha=1e-3 (a RELOCATED significance level, not eliminated); the family refine gate identity>=0.80 AND coverage>=0.50; the editing down-weight eps_j->0.2; the recombinant LLR margin. All named and exposed as flags, none buried.

Scope guardrail: the VG's value is as a combinatorial ASSIGNMENT object, NOT a read aligner (aligning reads to a sequence VG with vg giraffe = 94.5% < 98.0% for linear+PSV on a real 4-copy family, rescues 0), and junctions mostly do NOT define families (only retrocopy intronlessness is VG-native).

ONE LINE: each family = read-threaded paths through one PSV-bubble graph; the backbone collapses, copy differences become bubbles, and assignment is assign-or-abstain threading with a per-read identifiability certificate over provable structure (chi(H); facility-location) — no 1/k.

slides.anti_dismissal: Every soft spot is stated before you can find it: the ~10% floor's 'realness' is anchored to planted sim (not the two same-oracle real censuses), real-data accuracy is explicitly NOT claimed, the near-identical over-merge is shown, and every threshold is named — the honesty IS the defense against wishful thinking.
